DOES IT WORK?
14/ 15
of the top-15 predicted-riskiest held-out events are truly high-risk (random ≈ 0.4/15 — high-risk events are only 2.7% of the set). Reproduce: python src/orbitguard/ml/predict_demo.py
TASK
Predict each conjunction's final collision probability from CDMs issued ≥2 days before TCA, on the ESA Kelvins dataset (11,942 events, 323 high-risk). The model scores Kelvins CDMs, not yet our live globe (that's Phase 4).
PIPELINE
01

Propagatepropagate.py

Every object on one shared inertial frame (SGP4). Same frame is the invariant that makes pairwise distances meaningful.

02

Screenscreen.py

A KD-tree returns exactly the pairs a brute-force O(n²) scan would — verified, then run at scale.

03

Refinerefine.py

Analytic close-approach: from relative position/velocity, ΔT = −(r·v)/|v|², miss = |r + v·ΔT|. Exact for linear relative motion.

04

Rankrisk.py

Closing speed / (miss + ε), log-scaled — an explicit, inspectable proxy.

Reproduce every check: python -m orbitguard.validate · python tests/test_pipeline.py (9/9). Rigor and reproducibility are the point — see the About page for scope and honest limits.

WHAT IT IS

An open, transparent, reproducible reference implementation of an autonomous conjunction-screening + ML-risk pipeline. It pulls a live CelesTrak snapshot (16,103 objects this run), propagates every object on one inertial frame, screens the whole catalogue for close approaches, refines each to a precise time and miss distance, and ranks by risk — every step validated and inspectable.

Technical reviewers

An end-to-end system with real validation and an ML head — judged on method, not marketing.

Researchers & students

A reproducible astrodynamics + ML baseline; the ESA Kelvins CDM work is built in.

Agency research / education

ESA ran the Kelvins challenge we train on; a legible open reference for R&D and outreach.

Scope: a screening / analysis demonstrator on public TLEs — not an operational or safety-certified system, and not a replacement for covariance-based services (CARA, SOCRATES, commercial SSA). Public TLEs are ~km-accurate with no covariance, so the risk score is an explicit proxy, not a formal probability of collision. Validate against CelesTrak SOCRATES before any operational use.

ROADMAP
PHASE 0–2.5

v1 — Conjunction screener

Live catalogue → propagate → screen → refine → risk-rank → report + globe.

PHASE 3

ML risk model

Gradient-boosted + CNN models on ESA Kelvins CDMs. See Risk Model.

PHASE 4

Autonomy

Score live conjunctions with the learned model; propose a small avoidance Δv.

PHASE 5

Showcase

Polished writeup + demo — the flagship artifact.
